candidates.title: The Chair Outside The Door
candidates.one_line_concept: Aachu worries that going quiet makes her hard to love; Zuv answers by staying nearby without forcing the door open.
candidates.emotional_truth: Some people are not asking to be decoded immediately. They are asking not to be abandoned while they become speakable again.
candidates.relatable_trigger: The partner who shuts down but still wants to be found gently.
candidates.visual_potential: Closed door, practical chair, water, charger, folded cloth, light under the door, and a door crack can carry the whole story without forcing both faces.
candidates.why_people_may_share: A partner can send this as a soft thank-you or request: thank you for not making me explain before I can.
candidates.why_people_may_comment: People can name the private care rule their partner learned after shutdown or overwhelm.
candidates.risk_of_being_generic: Can become sad hallway wallpaper or saintly waiting unless the objects visibly change and the payoff stays ordinary.
candidates.suggested_text_hook: am i hard to love when i go quiet?
suggested_slide_arc: Closed door and chair ask the question.
Water, charger, and cloth appear without a second knock.
Chair distance, light, and object placement show learned restraint.
Door cracks open; Aachu uses what he left.
The changed hallway proves she was not abandoned while quiet.

candidates.title: The Little Instructions He Learned
candidates.one_line_concept: Aachu worries she is hard to handle, but Zuv has quietly learned the exact care rules that help her feel safe.
candidates.emotional_truth: Being known can look like boring logistics.
candidates.relatable_trigger: Couples with private care rules: snacks first, silence first, hold my hand but do not ask yet.
candidates.visual_potential: Water, charger, blanket, open doorway, and low light can show learned care without a speech.
candidates.why_people_may_share: It is the most taggable option because people can send it as 'you know my little instructions.'
candidates.why_people_may_comment: Comment bait is built in: what is your care instruction?
candidates.risk_of_being_generic: Can become care-label meme language or make Aachu look like a difficult object with settings.
candidates.suggested_text_hook: am i hard to handle, or did you learn me gently?
suggested_slide_arc: Aachu fears she is too much.
The room reveals tiny care rules he remembers.
He gives space without disappearing.
She realizes the care was learned, not improvised.
The object proof carries the answer.

candidates.title: The Bag That Knew Already
candidates.one_line_concept: Aachu worries she is hard to handle, while Zuv's ordinary bag reveals he already planned for her pressure points.
candidates.emotional_truth: Being loved by someone observant makes needs feel less like a performance and more like part of the route.
candidates.relatable_trigger: The partner who always packs the snack, charger, scarf, water, or exit plan.
candidates.visual_potential: Open bag, readable care objects, public place reduced to soft silhouettes, quiet corner payoff.
candidates.why_people_may_share: A lighter send to the partner whose bag is basically a love language.
candidates.why_people_may_comment: People can comment with the item their partner always remembers.
candidates.risk_of_being_generic: Can become Pinterest care-kit romance if the objects are too aesthetic or too many.
candidates.suggested_text_hook: am i hard to handle, or do i come with instructions?
suggested_slide_arc: Open bag introduces care objects.
Aachu is at the edge of a noisy place.
One object appears in use.
Zuv makes quiet space without performing rescue.
The used bag is the proof.

candidates.title: The Lamp Left Low
candidates.one_line_concept: Aachu asks whether she is hard to love, and the answer is the room becoming gentler before she has to.
candidates.emotional_truth: Reassurance can be environmental before it becomes verbal.
candidates.relatable_trigger: The partner who lowers the light, brings tea, and waits before asking what happened.
candidates.visual_potential: Light switch, lamp, phone face-down, cup, blanket, and guarded-to-open body language.
candidates.why_people_may_share: A quieter save-forward idea for people whose partner can read the room.
candidates.why_people_may_comment: People may comment with what their partner does before talking.
candidates.risk_of_being_generic: Can drift into pure bedroom atmosphere if object continuity is weak.
candidates.suggested_text_hook: am i hard to understand, or just hard to translate?
suggested_slide_arc: A too-bright room asks the question.
A hand lowers the lamp.
Tea, curtain, fan, and blanket change the room.
Aachu's hand accepts one care object.
Two cups sit in the softened light.

candidates.title: The Best Bite Under The Bowl
candidates.one_line_concept: Aachu asks if she is not enough while one saved bite shows her love has already been on the plate.
candidates.emotional_truth: Tiny offerings can contradict the fear of not being enough.
candidates.relatable_trigger: The couple ritual where the best bite silently belongs to the other person.
candidates.visual_potential: Plate, saved bite, small bowl, saucer, cup, and hands can tell a safe, quiet story.
candidates.why_people_may_share: People may send or comment with their best-bite rituals.
candidates.why_people_may_comment: Strong ritual comments, but less tied to the main hard-to-love concept.
candidates.risk_of_being_generic: Can imply Aachu proves worth by giving or self-erasing.
suggested_slide_arc: A saved bite asks the question.
Aachu covers the care before anyone thanks her.
Zuv notices.
The saucer proves recognition.
The returned object says the love was received.

candidates.title: The Exit Already Open
candidates.one_line_concept: Aachu fears she is not worth the risk, and Zuv makes an exit part of the plan so leaving the noise does not mean leaving the love.
candidates.emotional_truth: Real safety includes a way out without punishment.
candidates.relatable_trigger: The partner who knows the exit route, water bottle, and look that means now.
candidates.visual_potential: Exit door, soft silhouettes, route shape or keys, quiet landing, two cups.
candidates.why_people_may_share: A more intimate send to the person who plans exits without embarrassment.
candidates.why_people_may_comment: People can comment about space without punishment.
candidates.risk_of_being_generic: Can become rescue fantasy or break on crowd/phone/door logic.
suggested_slide_arc: A visible exit asks the question.
The plan exists before she asks.
Zuv creates space, not drama.
They step to a quiet edge.
The open door says leaving the room did not end belonging.
